summary: The fix is correct. `getOptionValueSourceWithGlobals` now checks whether each command has an own entry for the key, instead of checking whether the stored source is `undefined`. A global option whose source is explicitly undefined therefore masks the local source, as intended. `Object.hasOwn` is safe because `package.json` requires Node >=22.12. The new test covers the undefined-source case, and the existing test was renamed to describe its scenario more precisely. I found nothing to flag.
